about: What is known about the suite on each tablet, feature by feature. tools/dev/device_matrix.py turns it into the table in DEVICES.md and on the site (site/index.html, #tablets). A status is one of: v checked by the maintainer, r reported working by the tablet's owner, p partly checked, b built but not yet seen working, x doesn't work, n not offered on that tablet; a feature a tablet has no report for is left out of its cells. A cell with a note is [status, note]. A note's text is the same wherever it is used, and is numbered once.
